decided: Orbit commits on its own only at the end of proposing a change, applying it, reviewing it, walking its review findings, and archiving it. Checking a change's work and thinking a change through do not commit at their own end, as they never have; what they write is committed at the next of those five. A review or walk that is not about a change commits nothing.
alternatives: also commit at the end of checking a change's work and of thinking a change through, which would commit in the middle of a review that runs the check inside itself
why: The program wants the work committed throughout; committing inside a running review would split one review's work across two commits, and an exploration before its change exists has no pull request branch to commit to.
